fields.why: MSM is mostly a transmission category, but the article also uses 'predominantly gay neighborhoods', 'self-reported heterosexuals', 'the gay community' and asks clinicians for 'sexual orientation data'. Recording SOGI as a descriptor, without raising the level, is the better reading; omitting it is defensible under the MSM rule.

brief_issues: The MSM rule covers the level but not whether SOGI should be listed as a descriptor when the text uses orientation language. Both readers also recorded PFGE pattern sharing as a primary 'other' procedure; this is defensible under the lab-method exception but needs an explicit ruling. Both listed 'continuous' because of the median age of cases.
